title: right_click scenario's stated assertion (sel_pipe == 0) is never checked — the W3/W5 transcription is unpinned
detail: The scenario comment claims the pin (right-click selects, sel_pipe == 0), but check_states has no input_parity_right_click case and the expected stream covers only the Draw command. A broken parity_right_click_effect / unwired hook / pipe_hit regression passes green.
recommended_fix: Add case "input_parity_right_click": in check_states asserting r.sel_pipe == 0 (and sel_node == -1, sel_class == 0) after the right press.

title: class_cycle mouse leg is vacuous: sel_class preset 0 + .One SETs 0, so a dropped key still passes
evidence:
name = "input_parity_class_cycle",
	tier = tier_std,
	sel_pipe = 0, // a preset selection (the class keys gate on it)
	sel_class = 0,
	mouse = frames(
		evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .One}),
	),
---
case "input_parity_class_cycle":
	if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Mouse); ok && r.sel_class != 0 {
		append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s mouse: sel_class %d, want 0 (key SETS)", sc.name, r.sel_class))
	}
detail: The preset already sets sel_class = 0 and the .One key maps to Set_Class{0}; the assert 'want 0' passes even if mouse_map drops the Key_Press entirely. Only the pad leg (L_Bumper wrap 0→1) is a real pin.
recommended_fix: Preset sel_class = 1 (or another non-zero value) so the .One SET path must visibly change the state to pass.

title: Scenario frame scripts leak their [dynamic][]Device_Event backings (frames() allocations never freed)
detail: frames() heap-allocates each scenario's mouse/touch/pad dynamic backing; the defer frees only the inner slice data (delete(f)) and sc.expected, never the dynamic headers' own backings. ~11 scenarios x up to 3 dynamics leak per run (trivial, one-shot CLI).
recommended_fix: Also delete(sc.mouse), delete(sc.touch), delete(sc.pad) in the cleanup defer (or delete(&sc.mouse) etc. after the inner loops).
